meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional on release; partially revised with the next quarter's release and revised again later. DBIE keeps the first and the latest version of recent quarters; both are kept.
meta.product: India's overall balance of payments in rupees (DBIE report 57)
meta.coverage: Balance of payments in rupees, every line, credit, debit and net
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 57, ₹ crore: RBI's own rupee conversion of the dollar table, quarter by quarter. Not a separate measurement.
